faqs.question: Do Indian citizens need a visa for Bhutan?
faqs.answer: Indian passport holders do not require a visa, but MUST possess a valid passport (minimum 6 months validity) or Voter ID card to obtain an entry permit.

faqs.answer: The hike takes approximately 4-5 hours round trip. It is of moderate difficulty with well-defined trails, and ponies are available for hire on the lower section.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bali & Transfer to Kuta
itinerary.description: Arrive at Denpasar Airport. Private airport transfer to Eden Hotel in Kuta. Check-in and relax.

itinerary.title: South Bali Beach, Water Sports & Jimbaran Dinner
itinerary.description: Explore Nusa Dua beach for exciting water sports (seawalk included). Visit Pandawa Beach, attend the Kecak Dance Show in the evening, and enjoy a romantic candlelit seafood dinner on Jimbaran Beach.

itinerary.title: East Bali Temple & Waterfall Tour
itinerary.description: Early morning drive to East Bali to visit Lempuyang Temple (famous Gate of Heaven). Visit Tirta Gangga water palace and explore Kanto Lampo waterfall. Overnight in Kuta.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida West Coast Day Trip
itinerary.description: Take a fast boat from Sanur port to Nusa Penida. Tour the iconic Kelingking Beach, Broken Beach, Angel's Billabong, and swim in Crystal Bay. Fast boat back to Sanur and return to hotel.

itinerary.title: Ubud Nature, ATV Ride & Pool Villa Check-in
itinerary.description: Check out Kuta. Visit Tegalalang Rice Terraces, take a ride on the Bali Swing, try an ATV ride, and visit Tegenungan waterfall. Check in to a romantic Private Pool Villa in Ubud.

itinerary.title: Private Villa Relaxation & Floating Breakfast
itinerary.description: Enjoy a free day to relax in your villa, swim in your private pool, and experience a special floating breakfast. Optional spa therapies.

itinerary.title: Bali Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast at the villa, check out, and private transfer to Denpasar Airport for onward flight home.

title: Romantic Bali Escape with Private Pool Villa

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kuala Lumpur

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour & Batu Caves
itinerary.description: 8-hour tour covering Batu Caves, King's Palace, Dataran Merdeka, National Mosque, KL Tower, and Petronas Twin Towers. Watch the Petronas Towers illuminate at night.

itinerary.title: Fly to Langkawi Island
itinerary.description: Check out from KL hotel. Private transfer to airport for flight to Langkawi. Arrive in Langkawi, check in at beach hotel and relax.

itinerary.title: Langkawi Sky Bridge & Seven Wells
itinerary.description: Visit Langkawi Sky Bridge by taking the scenic Cable Car. Explore Seven Wells waterfall, and relax at Pantai Cenang beach in the evening.

itinerary.title: Kilim Mangrove Boat Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy a private boat tour of Kilim Mangrove Forest. Explore limestone caves, watch eagle feeding, and explore the Langkawi night market at your own pace in the evening.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast at the resort, check out, and private transfer to Langkawi Airport for return journey.

description: Venture on a cross-country tour from Ho Chi Minh City in the South to Hanoi in the North. Highlights include Notre Dame Cathedral, Hoi An lantern town, Hue tombs, Phong Nha Cave, Trang An karst landscapes, and Hanoi Old Quarter.

Personal expenses, drinks, tips and additional laundry

itinerary.title: Arrive in Saigon & Dinner Cruise
itinerary.description: Arrive in Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City). Visit Notre Dame Cathedral, Independence Palace, Thien Hau Pagoda, and Ho Thi Ky flower market. In the evening, enjoy a dinner cruise along Saigon River.

itinerary.title: Saigon to Da Nang & Hoi An Lantern Town
itinerary.description: Private airport transfer and fly to Da Nang. Visit the Marble Mountains, then drive to Hoi An. Check-in and enjoy an evening walking tour of lantern-lit Hoi An Ancient Town.

itinerary.title: Hoi An to Hue Imperial Tombs
itinerary.description: Visit Japanese Covered Bridge. Drive to Hue. Visit the Imperial Tombs of Minh Mang and Khai Dinh. In the evening, experience a Ca Hue traditional performance.

itinerary.title: Hue Imperial City to Quang Binh
itinerary.description: Visit the historical Hue Imperial City, Thien Mu Pagoda, and Dong Ba market. Private drive to Quang Binh, check-in and relax.

itinerary.title: UNESCO Phong Nha Cave to Ninh Binh
itinerary.description: Explore the UNESCO-listed Phong Nha Cave on a scenic river boat ride. View massive stalactites and stalagmites. Afternoon drive to Ninh Binh, check-in.

itinerary.title: Trang An Scenic Boat Ride to Hanoi
itinerary.description: Take a boat ride through caves and karst landscapes at Trang An Scenic Complex. Visit Bai Dinh Pagoda (Vietnam's largest spiritual complex). Drive to Hanoi. Walk through the Old Quarter.

itinerary.title: Hanoi City Tour & Departure
itinerary.description: Visit Temple of Literature, Tran Quoc Pagoda, and Hoan Kiem Lake. Private transfer to Hanoi Airport for departure.

itinerary.title: Airport Arrival & Negombo Beach
itinerary.description: Warm meet & greet at Bandaranaike Airport. Private transfer to the coastal town of Negombo. Check-in and relax at resort. Evening walk along Negombo Beach.

itinerary.title: Negombo to Dambulla & Sigiriya Rock
itinerary.description: Breakfast, check-out. Drive to Dambulla. En route enjoy fresh king coconuts and visit Dambulla Royal Cave Temple. Drive to Sigiriya, check-in, then climb the majestic Sigiriya Rock Fortress.

itinerary.title: Dambulla to Kandy Cultural Show
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check-out. Drive to Kandy. Visit Millennium Elephant Foundation to learn about elephant care. Check-in. In the evening, watch a Kandyan Cultural Dance & Fire Show.

itinerary.title: Kandy Temple & Drive to Nuwara Eliya & Ella
itinerary.description: Visit Temple of the Tooth Relic in Kandy. Drive to hill country. Visit Ramboda Falls and enjoy a tea plantation & factory tour. Drive to Ella, check-in.

itinerary.title: Nine Arch Bridge Train Ride to Yala
itinerary.description: Take the iconic mountain train ride from Ella to Demodara over the famous Nine Arch Bridge. Board private car and drive to Yala. Check-in and relax.

itinerary.title: Yala National Park Safari to Mirissa
itinerary.description: Early morning Yala National Park Jeep Safari to spot leopards, elephants, and bears. Drive to Mirissa, check in and enjoy Mirissa beach nightlife.

itinerary.title: Mirissa Leisure Day & Whale Watching
itinerary.description: Free day on the beach. Optional morning Whale Watching tour. Visit the beautiful Coconut Tree Hill and secret coves.

itinerary.title: Galle Fort Tour & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Check out. Visit Galle Dutch Fort & Lighthouse. Walk along the ramparts. Drive to Colombo Airport for return flight.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya Rock climb & Village Buffalo Cart Tour
itinerary.description: Early climb up Sigiriya Rock Fortress. Afternoon Sigiriya village tour with buffalo cart ride, lake canoe ride, cooking class, and homemade local lunch.

itinerary.title: Polonnaruwa Ruins to Pasikuda Beach
itinerary.description: Check out. Guided tour of Polonnaruwa (second capital ruins). Drive to coastal Pasikuda. Relax on white sand beaches.

itinerary.description: Full day at leisure in Pasikuda. Try snorkeling, jet skiing, or sunbathing.

itinerary.title: Kandy Temple & Peradeniya Gardens

description: Conquer Ladakh's epic mountain passes on a Royal Enfield Himalayan. This B2B group bike tour covers Leh local sightseeing, Khardung La pass, Nubra valley sand dunes, Pangong Tso lake, Shyok river ride, and Chang La pass. Complete with mechanic, backup car, and inner line permits.

faqs.question: Why is acclimatization required on Day 1?
faqs.answer: Leh is located at 11,500 feet. Severe altitude sickness can occur if you perform physical activity immediately. Resting on Day 1 ensures you stay fit for the ride.

included: 5 Nights accommodation (3N Leh, 1N Nubra, 1N Pangong) on triple sharing
Royal Enfield Himalayan 411 Bike for Day 2 to Day 5
Backup vehicle, professional mechanic & ride marshal
Helmet for rider and pillion, riding gear (knee guard, jacket, gloves)
Daily Breakfast and Dinner
Inner Line Permit for restricted border areas
Fuel as per the itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrive Leh & Leisure Acclimatization
itinerary.description: Leh airport pickup and check-in. Rest for complete acclimatization to high altitude. Evening visit to Leh Palace, Shanti Stupa, and local Leh market.

itinerary.title: Leh Local Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Test ride of Himalayan bikes. Sightseeing to Hall of Fame, Spituk Monastery, Magnetic Hill, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib, and Sangam Point where Indus & Zanskar rivers meet.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La Pass
itinerary.description: Ride over Khardung La Top (18,380ft), the world's highest motorable pass. Descend into Nubra Valley. Check-in at Hunder camps. Enjoy double-humped camel safari on sand dunes.

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley to Pangong Lake via Shyok
itinerary.description: Ride along the rocky Shyok River route to Pangong Lake (14,270ft). Watch the beautiful lake change color throughout the evening. Overnight stay in lakeside camps.

itinerary.title: Pangong Lake to Leh via Changla Pass
itinerary.description: Enjoy sunrise views at the lake. Check out and ride to Leh via Changla Pass (17,500ft). En route visit Rancho's School, Sindhu Ghat, and Thiksey Monastery.

itinerary.title: Leh Airport Departure Drop
itinerary.description: Breakfast, check out, and private transfer to Leh Airport for return flight home.
